parts.text: In this experiment, you will investigate the period of a pendulum. Complete the following instructions, referring to Fig. 1.1 and Fig. 1.2. Fig. 1.1 Fig. 1.2 A pendulum has been set up for you as shown in Fig. 1.1.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) The distance d is measured from the bottom of the clamp to the centre of the bob. • Adjust the length of the pendulum until d = 50.0 cm. • Displace the bob slightly and release it so that it swings. Fig. 1.2 shows one complete oscillation of the pendulum. • Measure, and record in Table 1.1, the time t for 10 complete oscillations. • Calculate, and record in Table 1.1, the period T of the pendulum. The period is the time for one complete oscillation. • Calculate T 2 and record the value in Table 1.1. • Write the unit for T 2 in the column heading.
